  - `defaultContainer()` for `Integer`
  - `naturalOrderContainer()` for `Comparable` types
  - `comparatorContainer(...)` for custom ordering

  - `binarySearch(T[] sortedArray, T target)`
  - `binarySearch(T[] sortedArray, T target, Comparator<? super T> comparator)`
- [BinarySearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/BinarySearchDemo.java) now runs through the generic container using `Integer[]`.
